passages.title: Cleanliness standards
passages.text:
MEMO
To: All staff, Harbor Café
From: Rosa Ibarra, General Manager
Date: September 3
Re: Cleanliness standards

Following several customer reviews that mentioned messy tables and cluttered counters, all staff must follow these standards beginning Monday, September 15.

1. Tables must be wiped within two minutes of guests leaving.
2. Staff belongings must be kept in the lockers in the back hallway, not on the counters or on the shelves behind the register.
3. The display case must be checked every hour and cleaned if necessary.
4. Supervisors will carry out spot checks each shift and record the results.

Staff who receive three or more "needs improvement" ratings in one month will be required to attend a refresher session. Thank you for helping us keep Harbor Café a welcoming place.

passages.title: Spot checks and lockers
passages.text:
To: Rosa Ibarra
From: Tuan Le, Shift Supervisor
Date: September 5
Subject: Spot checks and lockers

Hi Rosa,

I read your memo and have two questions. First, the lockers in the back hallway are only big enough for 10 people, but we have 14 staff on our busiest shift. Could we get four more by the 15th? Second, the display case is hard to check every hour during the lunch rush. May I assign this task to one person instead of the whole team?

Thanks,
Tuan

why.vi: "Following several customer reviews that mentioned messy tables".
why.en: The memo begins by citing customer reviews about messy tables.

questions.q: What is NOT required by the memo?

why.vi: Bản ghi nhớ không nhắc lau sàn mỗi giờ; chỉ yêu cầu kiểm tra tủ trưng bày mỗi giờ.
why.en: The memo never mentions mopping floors; only the display case is checked hourly.

questions.trap: Dễ nhầm "every hour" của tủ trưng bày với việc lau sàn.

questions.q: What problem does Mr. Le identify?
options: The spot checks take too long
The tables are hard to clean
The new rules start too early

why.vi: Tủ khóa chỉ đủ cho 10 người trong khi ca đông có 14 người.
why.en: The lockers fit 10 people, but 14 staff work the busiest shift.

questions.q: What will happen on the date Mr. Le mentions as "the 15th"?
options: The refresher session will be held

why.vi: Bản ghi nhớ: tiêu chuẩn mới áp dụng từ "Monday, September 15".
why.en: The memo says the standards begin on Monday, September 15.

questions.q: What does Mr. Le suggest about the display case checks?
options: One person could be responsible for them
They should be done every two hours
They are not necessary at lunch

why.vi: Anh hỏi: "assign this task to one person instead of the whole team".
why.en: He asks to assign the task to one person instead of the whole team.

passages.title: Airport messages
passages.text:
Marcus Dell (3:40 P.M.): Are you still at the airport?
Priya Shah (3:41 P.M.): Yes. My flight to Denver is delayed by two hours.
Marcus Dell (3:43 P.M.): That means you'll miss the dinner with the clients.
Priya Shah (3:44 P.M.): I know. Can you handle the opening remarks?
Marcus Dell (3:45 P.M.): Sure thing. I'll use your slides.
Priya Shah (3:46 P.M.): I'll send them in a minute. I'll join for dessert if I can.
Marcus Dell (3:47 P.M.): Don't rush. Everyone will understand.

questions.q: Why is Ms. Shah still at the airport?

why.vi: "My flight to Denver is delayed by two hours."
why.en: She says her flight is delayed by two hours.

questions.q: At 3:45 P.M., what does Mr. Dell mean when he writes, "Sure thing"?
options: He thinks the dinner will be canceled
He is sure the flight will leave soon
He agrees to give the opening remarks
He wants to use his own slides

why.vi: Cô Shah vừa nhờ "Can you handle the opening remarks?" và anh trả lời "Sure thing" là đồng ý.
why.en: Ms. Shah asks him to handle the opening remarks, and "Sure thing" means yes.

questions.trap: Anh dùng slide của cô Shah ("your slides"), nên đáp án slide riêng là sai.

questions.q: What is suggested about Ms. Shah?
options: She will skip the event completely
She will give the opening remarks
She may arrive late to the dinner

why.vi: Cô nói sẽ "join for dessert if I can", tức có thể đến muộn.
why.en: She says she may join for dessert, which implies arriving late.

questions.trap: Cô nhờ Marcus phát biểu mở đầu thay mình, nên không tự làm.
